architecture: Write an offline single-clip browser video editor from scratch. All source comes from your responses. One classic deferred app.js, no libraries/frameworks. Shared global app state, shared ui DOM references, named complete functions. app fields: loaded, busy, duration, start, end, filename, objectURL, downloadURL, recorder, chunks, canvas, ctx, raf, cancelled, audioContext, audioSource, audioDest. ui keys match DOM IDs: fileInput, preview, playBtn, seekInput, startInput, endInput, titleInput, exportBtn, cancelBtn, downloadLink, status, timeline, textOverlay, clipLabel, durationLabel, progressLabel. Functions: setStatus, setBusy, formatTime, loadVideo, togglePlay, seekVideo, validateTrim, updateTimeline, updateText, prepareCanvas, paintFrame, exportVideo, initEditor. Use browser-native video/Canvas/MediaRecorder APIs only. app.start/end are seconds, not percentages. Imported media stays in browser; no uploads. Real export must encode canvas frames, optionally attach audio via Web Audio. Maintain exact shared names. No demo assets or fake successful controls.

parts.name: Document
parts.task: Write a complete HTML document with title Clip Mini, UTF-8 charset, viewport, link to style.css, deferred script app.js. Body has class app and is entirely empty. Close body and html. No inline styles or implementation.

parts.name: Header
parts.task: Write one HTML header fragment, class topbar. Text brand Clip Mini. A disabled button with id exportBtn and label Export. A hidden button with id cancelBtn and label Cancel. A hidden download anchor with id downloadLink and label Download, download attribute and no href. Close header. No extra elements or CSS.

parts.name: Stage container
parts.task: Write one empty HTML div with class stage. It will later contain the editor panels. No document, comments, CSS or other elements.

parts.name: Status footer
parts.task: Write one HTML footer fragment with class statusbar. Include a span with id status and text Ready. Include a second EMPTY span with id progressLabel. Close footer. No other elements, document or styling.

parts.name: Koleksi media
parts.task: Generate HTML for an aside with class="library". Heading: "Media". Label: "Import video" wrapping an input id="fileInput" type="file" accept="video/mp4,video/webm". A div class="media-card" contains span id="clipLabel" text "No clip selected" and span id="durationLabel" text "MP4 or WebM". Hint: "Your files stay on this device". Use no IDs from other panels.

parts.name: Monitor video
parts.task:
Write an HTML fragment, with root section class="viewer".
First add a heading "Preview".
A div class="viewer-surface" contains exactly:
1. A video element with id="preview", playsinline, preload="metadata", src attribute absent, controls attribute absent.
2. An empty div with id="textOverlay" and class="text-overlay".
A div class="transport" contains exactly:
1. A button with id="playBtn", disabled, text "Play".
2. An input with id="seekInput", type="range", min="0", max="0", step="0.01", value="0", disabled, aria-label="Scrub video".
End with hint "Drag the playhead to preview". Close section. No other IDs, scripts, styles, or document tags.

parts.name: Properti klip
parts.task:
Generate HTML for an aside with class="inspector". Heading "Clip properties". Three labelled inputs:
- id="startInput", type="number", value="0", min="0", step="0.1", disabled, label "Start seconds"
- id="endInput", type="number", value="0", min="0", step="0.1", disabled, label "End seconds"
- id="titleInput", type="text", maxlength="120", placeholder="Add a title", label "Text overlay"
Hint "Trim selects the exported portion" and export summary "WebM / up to 720p / local". Use no other IDs.

parts.name: Timeline
parts.task: Write one HTML section with class="timeline-panel". Inside it, include h2 text Timeline. Then include a div with id="timeline" and class="timeline". The inner div must have tabindex="0", role="region", aria-label="Video timeline" and initial text Import a clip to begin editing. End the inner div and outer section. No buttons, scripts, styles, sample media or extra panels.

parts.context: First JavaScript part, no earlier globals.
parts.task: Declare one global const named app, as a plain object. Fields loaded,busy,cancelled=false; duration,start,end=0; filename empty string; objectURL,downloadURL,recorder,canvas,ctx,raf,audioContext,audioSource,audioDest=null; chunks empty array. No class, functions or DOM work. Output only the complete const declaration.

parts.name: DOM references
parts.task: Declare one global const ui, a plain object. Each key maps to document.getElementById of the SAME key. Keys: fileInput,preview,playBtn,seekInput,startInput,endInput,titleInput,exportBtn,cancelBtn,downloadLink,status,timeline,textOverlay,clipLabel,durationLabel,progressLabel. No functions, handlers or app redeclaration.

parts.name: Time formatter
parts.task: Write only function formatTime(value). Return mm:ss for a duration in seconds. First reject negative or nonfinite input: use Number.isFinite, because NaN has typeof number. Invalid values (NaN, Infinity, -1) must return 00:00. For valid input round down to whole seconds, divide by60 for minutes and take remainder for seconds; pad both to two digits. Examples: 0 -> 00:00; 65.9 -> 01:05; 3599 -> 59:59. No globals, classes, other functions, explanations or state changes.

parts.name: Status messages
parts.task: Write only function setStatus(message,isError=false). Set ui.status.textContent to message and toggle the error class using classList.toggle. No other functions, globals, classes or calls.

parts.name: Busy controls
parts.task:
Write ONLY complete JavaScript function setBusy(flag), following the behavior table below. Each target names an existing property, and the value is a logical description to implement in JavaScript. State busy means app.busy, loaded means app.loaded. Assign every listed target separately. Change no other property. Do not create classes, helper functions or extra globals. No explanation. Behavior table:
{
  "app.busy": "Boolean value of flag",
  "ui.fileInput.disabled": "busy",
  "ui.playBtn.disabled": "busy OR NOT loaded",
  "ui.seekInput.disabled": "busy OR NOT loaded",
  "ui.startInput.disabled": "busy OR NOT loaded",
  "ui.endInput.disabled": "busy OR NOT loaded",
  "ui.exportBtn.disabled": "busy OR NOT loaded",
  "ui.cancelBtn.hidden": "NOT busy"
}
parts.system_contract: app.loaded is a read-only input controlled by video metadata. Busy=false does NOT imply loaded=true. Do not assign or reset app.loaded. Only update app.busy and the listed UI properties.

parts.name: Impor media asli
parts.task: Parameter file is a browser File object: file.type is its MIME string, file.name is its filename. Never call startsWith on the File itself. Define only complete function loadVideo(file). Use existing app/ui/helpers. If busy return. Validate file is present and MIME starts video/; reject without destroying old video on invalid input. Revoke previous objectURL/downloadURL safely; createObjectURL(file), set preview.src, loaded=false until loadedmetadata. Set preview.onloadedmetadata to update loaded/duration/start0/endduration, start/end/seek input values and seek.max in seconds, clipLabel.textContent filename, durationLabel formatTime(duration), hide downloadLink until new export, setBusy(false), setStatus Ready, call updateTimeline and updateText. Set onerror to clear ready flag and show error. Do not invent Media/File helper classes or read file text. Don't autoplay on import. Audio, mediaRecorder and export are handled elsewhere. No other functions, globals or init handlers.

parts.name: Playback dan scrub
parts.task: Define complete functions togglePlay() async and seekVideo(value). Use app/ui actual shared state. Guard unloaded/busy. togglePlay pauses if playing; otherwise if currentTime outside [app.start,app.end) seek to start, then await preview.play with error handling. Set playBtn label appropriately. seekVideo clamps numeric seconds within0..app.duration and sets preview.currentTime, calls updateTimeline. Do not define event listeners here; final init handles timeupdate and trim end. No new globals, video classes, exports or playback timers.

parts.name: Trim dan timeline nyata
parts.task: Define validateTrim() returning boolean; parse ui.startInput/endInput numeric seconds and require finite0<=start<end<=duration. Invalid: setStatus error and disable exportBtn, keep previous valid app.start/end. Valid: update app.start/end, enable export unless busy, setStatus duration of selected clip, call updateTimeline. Define updateTimeline(): if no loaded media show truthful empty state. Otherwise use DOM createElement/textContent (safe filenames/text, no raw user HTML) to clear and render actual .timeline-ruler with duration, .track-row labelled Video and Text, .track-label, .track-lane. Video clip .video-clip absolute left/start divided duration percent, width (end-start)/duration percent, text filename and selected seconds; Text clip .text-clip exists only if titleInput has text. Each lane has .playhead at currentTime/duration percentage. Do not create IDs that duplicate controls; no fake sample footage. ui.seekInput.value updated from currentTime. Timeline click handler belongs to final init. No global app/ui redeclarations.

parts.name: Teks overlay
parts.task: Define ONLY updateText(). Assign ui.textOverlay.textContent from ui.titleInput.value safely, toggle hidden based on trimmed empty text, then call updateTimeline() if loaded. Do not make updateTimeline call updateText or cause recursive loops. No innerHTML from user text, no handlers or globals.

parts.name: Canvas ekspor
parts.task: Define prepareCanvas() using actual preview.videoWidth/videoHeight, require >0. Create offscreen canvas, width min(originalWidth,720), height rounded proportional ratio; get2d context, store app.canvas/app.ctx, throw descriptive errors if unsupported. Define paintFrame(): drawImage(preview,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height), then if titleInput nonempty draw centered white bold system-font overlay at x width/2,y height*.9; textAlign center, textBaseline middle, font max(14,round(width/30))px, dark shadow or stroke so visible; max text width90% canvas. This part only prepares/paints, no media recorder, loops, events or exports. Preserve shared fields.

parts.name: Encode WebM
parts.task: Define complete async exportVideo() ONLY, using existing helpers. Return if unloaded/busy or !validateTrim(). Check canvas.captureStream and MediaRecorder support; choose first supported MIME video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus then vp8,opus then video/webm. Clear cancelled/chunks, setBusy(true), hide old download, prepareCanvas. Await seek to app.start: attach one-shot seeked before changing currentTime; resolve immediately if already within .02; give timeout rejecting after5s. Paint first frame, canvas.captureStream(24). Try audio: lazily create AudioContext, createMediaElementSource(preview) ONCE, connect source to context.destination and a MediaStreamDestination, resume context and add its audio tracks to canvas stream. If audio unsupported continue with explicit silent-export status. Create MediaRecorder on stream, collect nonempty dataavailable blobs. onstop stops canvas video tracks (keep reusable audio destination track), cancels RAF, pauses video, resets play label; if cancelled clear blob and status Cancelled; otherwise create actual Blob chunks with recorder.mimeType, require nonzero bytes, revoke old downloadURL, createObjectURL, set downloadLink.href/download=clip-mini.webm, reveal it, setStatus Export ready with byte size and audio/silent info; finally setBusy(false), clear progress. onerror cleanly stop and show actual error. Start recorder BEFORE await preview.play(). A requestAnimationFrame loop paintFrame + progress percentage while playing; stop recorder when currentTime>=app.end-.025 OR preview.ended OR cancelled, set time to selected end. Cancel UI handler only sets app.cancelled; this loop owns stopping. Catch failures resets busy, stops recorder/tracks and reports error. No invented encoder classes, Node APIs, fake downloads of original, or new globals. Keep implementation concise and complete.

parts.name: Menghubungkan kontrol
parts.task: Define complete initEditor() then call it once. Add actual event handlers: fileInput.change calls loadVideo(first file), playBtn.click togglePlay, seekInput.input seekVideo(value), start/endInput.change validateTrim, titleInput.input updateText, exportBtn.click exportVideo, cancelBtn.click sets cancelled true. preview.timeupdate updates seekInput/playBtn and updateTimeline; when !busy and playing reaches app.end pause and show Play; preview.pause/ended updates label. timeline.click calculates seek seconds from clicked .track-lane bounding rectangle only (clamp0..duration) and calls seekVideo. Keyboard Space toggles playback unless target INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable, preventDefault; Escape cancels busy. Set initial setBusy(false), updateText and status Import a video to start. Add beforeunload revoking app URLs if present and cancelling RAF. Do not redefine any helper/state/functions. All DOM controls must really call defined earlier functions.
